title: rubus ellipticus var. wallichianus
intro: Rubus ellipticus var. wallichianus, commonly known as Himalayan raspberry, is a plant species belonging to the Rosaceae family. It has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including fever, diarrhea, and inflammation, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Rubus ellipticus var. wallichianus include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its medicinal value. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
